card.title: HAMPDEN Mk I
card.flavorText: The Hampden Mk I, full name Handley Page HP.52 Hampden, was a British twin-engine medium bomber used by the Royal Air Force during WWII. Early on the British realized that the aircraft was no match to the Luftwaffe fighters, and was therefore mostly used for nighttime operations. In 1942 the Hampden was withdrawn from Bomber Command, but it was used as a long-range torpedo bomber and reconnaissance aircraft to some extent after that.
